title: Labour–Fabian public register
tagline: An unofficial public directory of people with a published Fabian Society link — politicians, civil servants, academics, journalists, union officials, company directors and historical figures.
methodologyNote: Wikipedia category pages are used only as leads. A name is kept only if the article body states a Fabian role or membership, or if a non-Wikipedia page names that link. Where Wikipedia is the only citation, the record is labelled Wikipedia only. Authorship of a pamphlet is labelled separately and is not treated as proof of membership. Ordinary private members without a public source are not listed. A donation to the Labour Party is not a donation to the Fabian Society. A separate references library collects official, parliamentary, academic, news, Hansard, archive and critical pages that name the Society or Fabianism. Wikipedia appears once there as a hub. Forum dumps and antisemitic “secret Fabian” pages found in the wider scan were omitted.
limitations: This is not an official Fabian Society or Labour Party membership roll. It does not claim to list every member.
The Society’s 2024–25 annual report said 141 Fabian MPs were elected in 2024. That list has not been published. Names are not inferred from the total.
Wikipedia is a lead. Category membership alone is not enough: the article body must state a Fabian link. Wikipedia-only records are labelled as such.
Job titles and organisations are the last known public role found in the sources used. Wikidata offices can be stale; the person page says when a fact is Wikipedia-only.
A pamphlet, essay or conference listing is not treated as proof of membership unless the source also names a role or states membership.
A donation to the Labour Party is not a donation to the Fabian Society. Society gifts are recorded only where the Society or the Electoral Commission names them.
Member-only directories, leaked lists and paywalled Who’s Who entries were not used.
Government, parliamentary and Society pages change. Each source records the date it was checked.
